responsibility: This header publishes the GNU Modula-2 ASCII definition for the mc-boot runtime. It is the canonical interface for fixed character-code constants and aliases used by other runtime modules for text parsing, terminal I/O, formatting, and sentinel characters, and it contains no logic beyond the macro-level declaration of those stable ASCII values.
same_name_distinction: Interface-side half of the ASCII pair: unlike GASCII.cc's empty companion module, this header is the file other mc-boot sources include to obtain the `ASCII_*` macro definitions and aliases.
